notes.title: Next Quintillionaire - Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for your interest in "Next Quintillionaire"! My current plan is to prepare the demo sometime in the summer and to release the full game around November of this year. If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions, feel free to join the Discord (link is in the store page) or comment below. I am planning to do playtesting before the demo release and will likely organize all of that on Discord.

Let's make this game the best that it can be!

Monty
